title.en: In Nepal's flood-ravaged towns, excavators drown out the sound of grief
title.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏近3000人失踪搜救重启；悉尼女子安全获救

summary.en: Nepal has requested specialized foreign assistance as the search for survivors resumes following devastating flash floods that killed hundreds and left thousands missing in a region bordering Tibet. Amidst the disaster, a missing Sydney woman, Cara Severino, was safely located after contacting her parents.
summary.zh: 在造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水过后，尼泊尔已请求外国援助，搜救幸存者。在灾难中，一名失踪的悉尼女子卡拉·塞韦里诺在与父母取得联系后被安全找到。

body.en:
In Bidur, Nepal, the sound of people crying is drowned out by the constant hum of excavators.

This town sits more than 45 kilometres from the site of Wednesday's glacial collapse, which triggered mudslides and flash flooding, killing nearly 700 people.

More than 3,000 remain missing, including 42 Australians in Nepal. Chinese state media on Sunday reported six Australians were also missing on the Tibetan side of the border.

In Bidur, the torrent of water was so powerful that it destroyed the winding road that once ran through it, as well as most of the buildings lining it.

Sticking out of the mud are the ruins of what were once homes and businesses; now nothing more than concrete shells covered in brown sludge.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Menuka Manandhar struggles down a ladder leaning against one of the buildings after searching the ruins of her home.

The layers of mud surrounding it are so thick, two men have to help lift her back to safety.

"All my things were inside the house. I could only take some important documents.

"I was here when the disaster struck, we escaped it by only a minute. We had barely crossed the road when it hit."

Other families emerge with a few small bags of belongings they were able to salvage from the higher floors of their buildings.

"Five people in our family were downstairs at the time of the flood," Ramji Lamsa, who was sheltering in a nearby school, said.

"I had a shop, a storehouse, and some vehicles. Everything was swept away. We don't have any resources to rebuild. We don’t know how the authorities are going to handle this."

Everything north of Bidur remains cut off by land. Nepali rescue crews are sending helicopters back and forth throughout the day, bringing back the injured and the dead they find on the other side.

Gaurav Thapa Magar was working in his bank at Timure, just three kilometres from the Tibetan border, when everything around him started shaking.

"In that moment, I just ran with everyone. And after I had taken five or six steps, I saw a big wall of water, almost three of four storeys of water, coming right after me.

"I felt like I was dead, to be honest. I was panicking, everyone was panicking, but I was really thinking 'I’m gone, I have to run, I’m gone'.

Gaurav spent most of the day waiting at the top of the hill he had climbed to, looking down on the wasteland that once was his town, until a helicopter arrived and evacuated him.

"When I looked down the whole village were swept away. And people were saying: 'There’s a body, there's a body'.

"There were so many people crying, who had lost their families. And there were so many people who were...
body.zh: 尼泊尔当局在因天气原因短暂暂停后恢复搜救工作，在一场造成数百人死亡并席卷西藏边境地区的毁灭性洪水之后，寻找近 3,000 名失踪人员。 周六，一名下落不明的悉尼女子，26 岁的卡拉·塞维里诺 (Cara Severino) 与她的父母取得了联系，随后澳大利亚领事官员安全找到了她。 外交部长黄英贤表示，这是“在一场带来巨大损失和不确定性的灾难中罕见的积极消息”。 “我对那些仍然失踪的人的家人感到同情——我知道我的家人和朋友经历了多少，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我很幸运来自澳大利亚，并得到大使馆和澳大利亚政府的大力支持。” 周三，冰川崩塌引发岩石、冰块、泥浆和碎片涌入山区河流系统，造成尼泊尔至少 669 人死亡、中国西藏至少 7 人死亡，造成 41 名澳大利亚人下落不明。 目前仍有近3000人失踪，其中尼泊尔约2426人，西藏吉隆县约554人，其中至少有540名外国人，其中许多是来自印度的印度教朝圣者。 尼泊尔已呼吁提供专门的外国援助，其财政部长表示，重建需要高达 50 亿美元（70 亿美元）的资金。 受灾严重的拉苏瓦地区一名警官表示，搜救行动因雨和雾而暂时停止，并于周日下午恢复。 “直升机正在飞行，天气有所好转后，行动也恢复了，”他不愿透露姓名，因为他无权接受媒体采访。 周五，洪水发生后，尼泊尔和中国边境形成的一个湖泊开始溢出，流入尼泊尔的伦德科拉河和特里苏利河，当局还暂停了救援工作。 中国当局和中央电视台表示，到周六，风险已经缓解，部分湖床清晰可见。据中央电视台报道，卫星图像显示湖水正在慢慢流失，湖面逐渐缩小。 该湖是尼泊尔正在监测的洪水区上游的两个湖之一。一位官员警告说，在两者完全排干之前，洪水风险将持续存在。 灾难发生三天后，当局表示，一些被打捞出来的尸体已经腐烂得面目全非。由于健康风险和对疾病爆发的恐惧，他们将在办理法律手续后被埋葬。 奇特旺地区政府在一份通知中表示，“将收集 DNA 样本，并将尸体埋在露天场所。” 失踪澳大利亚人的几名家人和朋友已飞往尼泊尔......

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, the news of Cara Severino's safe return offers a glimmer of hope. This story reminds us of the profound uncertainty faced by families during disasters, and the importance of advocating for the vulnerable, ensuring no one is forgotten in the chaos.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性洪水肆虐之际，卡拉·塞韦里诺安全获救的消息带来了一线希望。这个故事提醒我们，在灾难中，家属们面临着巨大的不确定性，以及为弱势群体发声、确保混乱中无人被遗忘的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Death toll from Nepal-Tibet floods rises to over 600
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数升至600多人

summary.en: Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region. The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to...
summary.zh: 致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔-西藏边境地区三天后，大雨使本已艰难的救援工作更加复杂，仍有数百人失踪。据报道，周六尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性山洪的最新死亡人数已超过600人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的紧急救援行动进入第四天。根据尼泊尔灾害机构的数据，尼泊尔的死亡人数现已达到626人，包括外国人在内的2,426人仍然失踪。在边境另一侧的...

body.en:
Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region.

The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to search for hundreds of missing people entered a fourth day.

Figures from both countries put the number of missing close to 3,000, with 682 bodies recovered and reports of corpses swept as far downstream as India.

According to Nepal 's disaster agency, the death toll there now stands at 675, with 2,426 people — including foreigners — still missing.

Across the border in Tibet, China's state news agency, Xinhua, has confirmed seven deaths and reported 554 missing individuals.

A glacial collapse on Wednesday sent rock, ice, mud and debris surging through the Himalayan mountain river systems below.

The flood swept through areas near the Chinese border, ravaging entire towns and damaging hydropower plants.

Nepal army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet told the media on Saturday that helicopter operations were on hold until the weather improved.

Rescuers are battling thick layers of mud in the affected areas, which is making it difficult for helicopters to land and take off.

The army has located people trapped in a tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project in Nepal's Rasuwa District. Over 100 people are believed to be inside the tunnel filled with mud.

Basnet said that rescuers were struggling to locate the entry points of the tunnel and had made use of  baskets and ropes to reach some people. There are also limited places for helicopters to land in the area.

On Friday, Nepal's Army shared visuals of some people being rescued from the tunnel. The survivors were seen stuck in the mud, while officials crawled through the sludge and held out their hands to them.

On Saturday, Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal said a specialized tunnel rescue team had arrived from neighboring India and was ready to start work.

Nepalese authorities said the bodies of many flood victims have also been found dozens of kilometers from the disaster zone in Chitwan District in southern Nepal, which borders India.

Meanwhile, Indian authorities said they recovered the bodies of seven people who were swept downstream from Nepal and believe them to be flood victims.

Late on Friday, Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told the Reuters news agency that his country needed equipment, along with technical knowledge in tunnel rescue operations.

Khanal also told Reuters that Nepal did not need help with search and rescue operations but needed assistance in opening transport and communication lines in places...
body.zh: 大雨使本已困难的救援工作变得更加复杂，在致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区三天后，仍有数百人失踪。 周六，据报道尼泊尔-西藏边境毁灭性山洪造成的最新死亡人数已超过 600 人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的疯狂救援行动已进入第四天。 据尼泊尔救灾机构称，尼泊尔目前死亡人数为 626 人，仍有 2,426 人失踪，其中包括外国人。 在边境另一边的西藏，中国官方通讯社新华社已确认 7 人死亡，并报告了 554 人失踪。 周三的冰川崩塌使岩石、冰、泥土和碎片涌入下面的喜马拉雅山区河流系统。 洪水席卷了中国边境附近的地区，摧毁了整个城镇并损坏了水电站。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特 (Raja Ram Basnet) 周六对媒体表示，直升机行动暂停，直至天气好转。 救援人员正在受影响地区与厚厚的泥浆作斗争，这使得直升机难以着陆和起飞。 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区Trishuli 3A水电项目隧道内，军队已找到被困人员。据信，隧道内有超过 100 人，里面充满了泥土。 巴斯内特说，救援人员正在努力找到隧道的入口点，并使用篮子和绳索来救助一些人。该地区直升机的降落地点也有限。 周五，尼泊尔军队分享了一些人从隧道中被救出的画面。人们看到幸存者被困在泥里，而官员们则爬过污泥并向他们伸出双手。 尼泊尔当局表示，在与印度接壤的尼泊尔南部奇旺地区，距离灾区数十公里的地方也发现了许多洪水遇难者的尸体。 与此同时，印度当局表示，他们找到了从尼泊尔下游被冲走的七人的尸体，并认为他们是洪水受害者。 周五晚些时候，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔告诉路透社，尼泊尔需要设备以及隧道救援行动的技术知识。 卡纳尔还告诉路透社，尼泊尔不需要搜救行动方面的帮助，但需要援助来开通桥梁被毁地区的交通和通讯线路、尸体身份识别、DNA测试以及尸体的长期储存。 路透社援引卡纳尔的话称：“我们已经在我们没有足够专业知识和技术知识的领域提出了此类专业服务和技术援助的请求。”

reflection.en: The devastating flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border, leaving over 600 dead and hundreds missing, bring immense sorrow. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, "Jesus wept," reminds us that grief is a deeply human and even divine response to suffering and death. Our hearts go out to the families in the Nepal-Tibet border...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性的山洪造成600多人死亡，数百人失踪，带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此深重的损失面前，圣经中最短的经文“雅伟哭了”提醒我们，悲伤是对苦难和死亡的一种深刻的人性甚至神性的回应。我们的心与尼泊尔-西藏边境地区那些正在应对这场悲剧的家庭同在。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
title.zh: 西藏洪水画面未在中国境内播放，受害者信息鲜为人知

summary.en: Dramatic footage of deadly flash flooding in Tibet, specifically at Gyirong Port, which swept away everything in its path and claimed hundreds of lives, has been largely hidden from public view and censored on the internet within China.
summary.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸发生致命山洪，洪水冲毁一切，造成数百人死亡，但相关震撼画面和信息在中国境内被大量隐藏，并在互联网上受到审查。

body.en:
The dramatic footage was almost impossible to miss. A torrent of water tearing through Gyirong Port, one of the main border crossings between Nepal and Tibet, sweeping away all in its path as hundreds of people fled for their lives.

The scenes, captured by CCTV cameras, quickly spread on social media and onto screens around the world.

Only a single still-frame shot has been broadcast so far by the country's state-run flagship news bulletin.

It has also been difficult to find the full video on China's heavily censored internet. Although various aspects of the disaster have been discussed online.

But what is even harder to find is any first-hand accounts of survivors describing the flash flooding that has claimed hundreds of lives, with just as many still unaccounted for since Wednesday.

Beijing has launched a massive rescue operation involving hundreds of emergency workers, which is continuing, and President Xi Jinping chaired an emergency meeting with officials to co-ordinate efforts.

But when you compare the country's internet content to what much of the world has been seeing online these past few days, China's firewall becomes more visible than ever.

Tibet, which Beijing annexed in the 1950s, had long resisted rule by the Chinese Communist Party.

China has quashed protests over the years, sometimes violently, and has been accused of grave rights violations in the Buddhist region. It has labelled the exiled spiritual leader, the Dalai Lama, a separatist.

That history means the very name Tibet draws China's censors. Beijing's sensitivities are especially apparent at times likes this.

There have been daily updates on the missing and the dead, and Beijing has also been posting updates on the rescue operations, as well as the dangers posed by a barrier lake that has been at risk of overflowing.

On Saturday, new footage from Chinese state media showed rescue teams wandering in a wasteland of mud and rock while calling out to anyone trapped.

But there is little detail beyond that. There are no accounts from survivors in Tibet, and almost no user-generated footage showing the deadly moments or their aftermath.

We are yet to hear from anxious families of those missing. Trying to contact people there is near-impossible during regular times.

As a journalist who has covered North Korea, it has often been easier for me to contact interviewees in Pyongyang than it is in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.

On Thursday night, as global headlines led on the devastation in a Himalayan valley, China's state broadcaster opened its main bulletin with the launch of Xi's new book, a selection of his "most important and fundamental works".

Foreign journalists cannot travel to Tibet without government permission. We have just a few hours to get as much information...
body.zh: 戏剧性的镜头几乎不可能被错过。尼泊尔和西藏之间的主要边境口岸之一吉隆口岸发生洪流，洪水冲垮了沿途的一切，数百人逃命。 这些场景被闭路电视摄像机捕捉到，迅速在社交媒体和世界各地的屏幕上传播。 到目前为止，该国官方旗舰新闻公报只播放了一个静态画面。 在中国严格审查的互联网上也很难找到这段视频。同样很难找到描述这场夺去了数百人生命的山洪的帖子，自周三以来仍有同样多的人下落不明。 北京已启动了涉及数百名应急人员的大规模救援行动，该行动仍在继续，国家主席习近平主持召开了官员紧急会议，协调救援行动。 但当你将中国的互联网内容与过去几天世界上大部分地区在网上看到的内容进行比较时，中国的防火墙变得比以往任何时候都更加明显。 北京在 20 世纪 50 年代吞并的西藏长期以来一直反抗中国共产党的统治。 多年来，中国镇压了抗议活动，有时甚至是暴力镇压，并被指控在佛教地区严重侵犯人权。它给流亡精神领袖达赖喇嘛贴上了分离主义者的标签。 这段历史意味着中国审查机构用“西藏”这个名字来命名。北京的敏感性在这种时候尤其明显。 每天都有关于失踪和死亡的最新消息，北京也一直在发布救援行动的最新消息，以及堰塞湖面临溢出风险所带来的危险。 周六，中国官方媒体的新镜头显示，救援队在一片泥泞和岩石的荒地上徘徊，同时向被困人员呼救。 但除此之外就没有什么细节了。没有西藏幸存者的叙述，也几乎没有用户生成的视频显示致命时刻或后果。 我们还没有收到失踪者焦急的家人的消息。平时想要联系那里的人几乎是不可能的。 作为一名报道朝鲜的记者，我在平壤联系受访者往往比在西藏首府拉萨更容易。 周四晚上，当全球头条新闻报道喜马拉雅山谷的灾难时，中国国家广播公司以习近平新书的发布作为其主要公报的开篇，该书精选了他的“最重要和最基础的著作”。 未经政府许可，外国记者不得前往西藏。在视频被删除、声音被压制之前，我们只有几个小时的时间来尽可能多地获取有关此类重大事件的信息。 相反，我们必须依靠...

reflection.en: The tragic flash flooding in Tibet, particularly at Gyirong Port, has left hundreds dead or unaccounted for, yet dramatic footage and details remain largely hidden from the Chinese public. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to open our mouths for the mute, reminding us of the moral imperative to acknowledge and amplify the suffering of the vulnerable. Even when...
reflection.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸的洪水灾情造成数百人死亡或失踪，然而，相关的震撼画面和详细信息在中国公众面前却被大量隐藏。箴言31:8呼吁我们为不能发声的人开口，提醒我们有道德责任去承认并放大弱势群体的苦难。即使信息被压制，受苦者的呼声依然回荡，敦促我们为他们的困境发出同情和声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Satellite images reveal scale of flood devastation in Nepal villages
title.zh: 卫星图像揭示尼泊尔村庄洪灾破坏规模

summary.en: Satellite imagery has revealed the scale of devastation along Nepal's Trishuli River following a deadly flash flood triggered by a glacier collapse on Wednesday. The torrent destroyed villages, bridges, and a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing, leaving hundreds dead and thousands missing.
summary.zh: 卫星图像揭示了周三因冰川坍塌引发的特大山洪对尼泊尔特里舒利河沿岸造成的破坏规模。洪流摧毁了村庄、桥梁和尼泊尔与西藏之间的一个关键边境口岸，造成数百人死亡，数千人失踪。

body.en:
New satellite imagery has revealed the scale of the devastation along Nepal's Trishuli River caused by Wednesday's deadly flash flood, triggered by a glacier collapse.

Before-and-after images show how sections of the valley, where a torrent of floodwater and debris surged through, destroyed villages, bridges and hydroelectric power stations.

Hundreds of people have been killed and thousands more are missing, Nepalese officials say.

Among the worst-hit locations reviewed by BBC Verify was a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing, which was engulfed by a rush of floodwater and captured on camera.

The satellite imagery from US-based intelligence firm Vantor, shows the site has been almost entirely washed away. Shocking CCTV footage showed the moment as the deluge of water swept over buildings as people tried to escape.

Damage and mud can be seen more than 2.5km (1.5 miles) upstream, reaching 100m (330 ft) above the area it first hit.

A few miles further south is the village of Timure, which has now largely disappeared.

The walls of the valley at this point are steep, reaching up to 50m above the water line. The image shows most of the houses perched on this slope are now gone or covered in mud.

A further 10km (eight miles) downstream, where the Trishuli River winds through Syapru Besi, satellite imagery now shows the village covered by mud, rock and other debris. Houses and other structures have disappeared, including bridges and a hydroelectric power station.

One of the larger villages to be struck by the full force of the flood was Trishuli, where some of the earliest verified footage of the disaster emerged from.

A satellite image of the town and surrounding agricultural land, which is about 45km (28 miles) downstream from the border, show an entire neighbourhood has been essentially washed away.

Verified videos of the town show a bridge collapsing as the river surges forward. At the very same moment from ground level, footage filmed from inside a bus shows people crying out in distress and trying to flee as they see the water rushing down the river.

Other dramatic videos show people sheltering inside a house, peering over the edge of a balcony as they watch a torrent of floodwater wash away almost everything around them, knocking large metal debris and a vehicle toward the building.

Somehow the house remains intact and survivors can be seen in a second verified video standing surrounded by mud once the floodwater had receded.

Imagery from satellite provider Planet Labs released today has also provided a clearer view of the disaster's origins at the collapsed glacier, the moment of which has been captured on a verified drone video.

The satellite image shows an enormous chunk of the glacier has fallen away, carving an enormous path of rock...
body.zh: 新的卫星图像揭示了周三冰川崩塌引发的致命山洪对尼泊尔特里苏利河沿岸造成的破坏规模。 前后照片显示了洪水和瓦砾汹涌而过的山谷部分地区如何摧毁了村庄、桥梁和水力发电站。 尼泊尔官员称，数百人死亡，数千人失踪。 BBC verify 审查的受灾最严重的地点之一是尼泊尔和西藏的一个重要过境点，该过境点被洪水淹没，并被摄像机拍摄到。 美国情报公司 Vantor 的卫星图像显示，该地点几乎完全被冲毁。令人震惊的闭路电视画面显示，当人们试图逃离时，洪水席卷建筑物。 在上游超过 2.5 公里（1.5 英里）处可以看到损坏和泥浆，到达其首次袭击区域上方 100 m（330 英尺）。 再往南几英里是蒂穆尔村，该村现已基本消失。 此时的山谷壁很陡，高出水线高达 50m。该图像显示，坐落在这个斜坡上的大多数房屋现在都已经消失或被泥土覆盖。 再往下游 10 公里（8 英里）处，Trishuli 河蜿蜒穿过 Syapru Besi，卫星图像现在显示该村庄被泥土、岩石和其他碎片覆盖。房屋和其他建筑物都消失了，包括桥梁和水力发电站。 Trishuli是遭受洪水全面袭击的较大村庄之一，一些最早经过核实的灾难镜头就来自那里。 该镇及周边农田（距离边境下游约 45 公里（28 英里））的卫星图像显示，整个社区基本上已被冲走。 经核实的该镇视频显示，随着河流汹涌澎湃，一座桥梁倒塌。就在同一时刻，从地面拍摄的公交车内拍摄的视频显示，人们看到河水顺流而下，痛苦地呼喊并试图逃跑。 其他戏剧性的视频显示，人们躲在房子里，从阳台边缘往外看，看到洪水冲走了他们周围的几乎所有东西，将大块金属碎片和一辆汽车冲向建筑物。 不知何故，房子仍然完好无损，在第二段经过验证的视频中可以看到洪水退去后幸存者被泥土包围。 卫星提供商 Planet Labs 今天发布的图像也提供了冰川崩塌灾难起源的更清晰视图，经过验证的无人机视频捕捉到了这一瞬间。 卫星图像显示，一大块冰川已经消失，形成了一条巨大的岩石道路……

reflection.en: The images of the Trishuli River valley being engulfed by debris remind us of the 'groaning' of a world subject to sudden, overwhelming natural forces. As we see homes and vital crossings washed away, we are confronted with the fragility of our earthly structures and the deep grief of those who have lost everything. We look to Yahweh to be near the...
reflection.zh: 特里舒利河谷被瓦砾和洪流吞没的景象提醒我们，受造之物在面对突如其来的巨大自然力量时正处于“叹息劳苦”之中。当我们看到家园和关键通道被冲走，我们直面人类建筑的脆弱以及那些失去一切的人们深重的悲哀。我们仰望雅伟，祈求祂亲近尼泊尔那些伤心的人，并为正在进行的搜救工作提供力量。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet flood deaths pass 500, thousands still missing
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数超500，数千人仍失踪

summary.en: The Red Cross says more than 93,000 people are affected by the deadly floods and landslides on the China-Nepal border. Rescue efforts were temporarily paused after an overflowing lake threatened to trigger more floods.
summary.zh: 红十字会表示，中尼边境的致命洪灾和山体滑坡已影响超过93,000人。由于一个溢流的湖泊可能引发更多洪水，救援工作曾一度暂停。

body.en:
The Red Cross says more than 93,000 people are affected by the deadly floods and landslides on the China-Nepal border. Rescue efforts were temporarily paused after an overflowing lake threatened to trigger more floods.

Rescue workers have resumed a search for hundreds of people still missing two days after  catastrophic flash flooding  hit the border between  Nepal and  China . 

Their efforts were briefly put on hold on Friday after a lake formed by debris began overflowing, threatening areas already devastated by the disaster.  

"We have received a notice saying that the lake has broken its banks," Narendra Pariyar, the most senior bureaucrat of the hard-hit Rasuwa district, told DW. "We can see that the level of water in the river is rising."

Residents in Nepal's border district of Rasuwa were seen fleeing up hillsides as they braced for a surge in river levels, Reuters reported.

Authorities later said the threat had eased but that they were closely monitoring the situation. 

Meanwhile, Nepal said the death toll had risen to 579,  up from 390 a day earlier . China has updated its earlier count of three to five deaths in Tibet.

More than 2,000 are still believed to be missing, including over 500 foreigners from more than 30 countries.

The International Red Cross estimated that over 93,000 people have been directly affected by the catastrophe and are in urgent need of humanitarian assistance.

"We're of course very concerned about a secondary flood," said spokesman David Fisher at a press briefing in Geneva, adding that Red Cross relief trucks had been blocked by the lake which formed following the landslide.

Kamal Kishore, Head of the United ​Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, warned of further "cascading hazards that might unfold" and said: "The disaster is ⁠not ​yet completely over. It is still ​unfolding in some ways."

The World Health Organization (WHO) warned of the risk of disease in the wake of the disaster.

"Following a disaster of this scale, displacement, overcrowding ⁠and disruption ​to water, sanitation and health services can increase the risk of infectious diseases, including diarrhoea and respiratory illnesses," said spokesman Tarik ​Jasarevic.

Wednesday's disaster, triggered by a glacial collapse that sent rock and meltwater surging into rivers below, left a new danger in its wake: a barrier lake formed upstream by debris dams. 

China's Ministry of Water Resources said the lake held roughly 2 million cubic meters of water as of Thursday and was expected to receive another 3 million cubic meters — equivalent to about 1,200 Olympic swimming pools — over the following three days, with peak flow expected around September...
body.zh: 红十字会表示，超过 93,000 人受到中尼边境致命洪水和山体滑坡的影响。由于湖水泛滥，可能引发更多洪水，救援工作暂时停止。 尼泊尔和中国边境发生灾难性山洪暴发两天后，救援人员已重新开始搜寻仍失踪的数百人。 周五，由于碎片形成的湖泊开始泛滥，威胁到已经遭受灾难破坏的地区，他们的努力被短暂搁置。 受灾最严重的拉苏瓦地区最高官员纳伦德拉·帕里亚尔 (Narendra Pariyar) 告诉德国之声：“我们收到通知，称该湖已决堤。” “我们可以看到河里的水位正在上升。” 据路透社报道，尼泊尔边境拉苏瓦地区的居民纷纷逃上山坡，以应对河流水位上涨的情况。 当局后来表示，威胁已经缓解，但他们正在密切关注事态发展。 与此同时，尼泊尔表示死亡人数已从一天前的 390 人上升至 579 人。 中国更新了此前西藏三至五人死亡的统计数据。 据信仍有 2,000 多人失踪，其中包括来自 30 多个国家的 500 多名外国人。 国际红十字会估计，超过93,000人直接受到这场灾难的影响，急需人道援助。 发言人大卫·费舍尔在日内瓦举行的新闻发布会上表示：“我们当然非常担心二次洪水。”他补充说，红十字会的救援卡车被山体滑坡后形成的湖泊堵塞。 联合国减少灾害风险办公室主任卡迈勒·基肖尔警告称，“可能会出现更多连锁危险”，并表示：“灾难尚未完全结束。在某些方面，它仍在继续发展。” 世界卫生组织（WHO）就灾难发生后的疾病风险发出警告。 发言人塔里克·贾萨雷维奇 (Tarik Jasarevic) 表示：“如此规模的灾难发生后，流离失所、过度拥挤以及供水、卫生和医疗服务中断可能会增加感染腹泻和呼吸道疾病等传染病的风险。” 周三的灾难是由冰川崩塌引发的，冰川崩塌导致岩石和融水涌入下面的河流，随之而来的是一个新的危险：上游由碎片坝形成的堰塞湖。 中国水利部表示，截至周四，该湖的蓄水量约为 200 万立方米，预计在接下来的三天内将再接收 300 万立方米的水，相当于约 1,200 个奥运游泳池，预计 9 月左右将达到峰值流量。

reflection.en: The devastating floods and landslides along the China-Nepal border, affecting over 93,000 people and leaving thousands missing, remind us of the relentless nature of some crises. Even as rescue efforts are paused due to further threats, the promise of Yahweh's mercies, new every morning, offers a steadfast hope. In the face of such sustained devastation, we...
reflection.zh: 中尼边境毁灭性的洪灾和山体滑坡影响了超过93,000人，并导致数千人失踪，这提醒我们有些危机是持续不断的。即使救援工作因新的洪水威胁而暂停，雅伟的慈爱每天早晨都是新的，这提供了坚定的盼望。面对如此持续的破坏，我们为那些承受巨大损失和不确定性的人们祈求每日的力量和安慰。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: How Australians can help those impacted by devastating Nepal floods
title.zh: 澳大利亚人如何帮助受尼泊尔毁灭性洪水影响的人们

summary.en: Australian charities have launched a joint appeal to aid communities devastated by floods and landslides along the Nepal-China border. Thousands are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean water, and medical care after their homes and infrastructure were destroyed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚慈善机构已发起联合募捐，以援助尼泊尔-中国边境受洪水和山体滑坡摧毁的社区。在房屋和基础设施被毁后，成千上万的人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。

body.en:
Entire communities have been devastated by severe flooding and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border, with homes, roads, bridges and critical infrastructure destroyed.

Search and rescue operations remain underway, while thousands of people are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean drinking water and medical assistance.

In response, 14 Australian charities have joined forces to launch a national appeal.

The Emergency Action Alliance (EAA) has launched the Nepal Flood Disaster Appeal, bringing together a variety of charities to support communities affected by the disaster.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The alliance says donations will help provide immediate humanitarian assistance, including emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, hygiene supplies and medical care.

Access to some affected communities remains difficult, with damaged roads and ongoing weather conditions hampering efforts to reach people in need.

Australians are encouraged to donate through the EAA website or by calling 1300 939 000.

The charities participating in the appeal are Save the Children Australia, Plan International Australia, Oxfam Australia, Australia for UNHCR, ActionAid Australia, CARE Australia, Caritas Australia, ADRA, Act for Peace, Anglican Overseas Aid, Australian Lutheran World Service, Baptist World Aid Australia, CBM Australia and Tearfund Australia.

EAA executive director Kerren Morris said the appeal provided Australians with a trusted way to support people affected by the disaster.

"Emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water and medical support are urgently needed now, while longer-term recovery efforts will continue for many months," she said in a statement.

The charities involved bring different areas of humanitarian expertise to the response, with organisations and their local partners working to provide immediate assistance to affected communities.

Save the Children is focusing on supporting children and families affected by humanitarian emergencies.

Oxfam Australia's humanitarian work includes support for essential services such as clean water, sanitation and emergency assistance.

Australia for UNHCR is the UN refugee agency's national partner in Australia, and is supporting humanitarian assistance through the UNHCR network.

The charities involved are continuing to assess the scale of the disaster and humanitarian needs in affected communities.

The EAA says its members are working to determine where support is most urgently needed as search and rescue operations continue.

The appeal has been endorsed by the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), the peak body for Australian non-government organisations...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏边境沿线的严重洪水和山体滑坡摧毁了整个社区，房屋、道路、桥梁和重要基础设施被毁。 搜救行动仍在进行中，数千人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。 作为回应，14家澳大利亚慈善机构联手发起全国呼吁。 紧急行动联盟（EAA）发起了尼泊尔洪灾呼吁，汇集了各种慈善机构来支持受灾社区。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该联盟表示，捐款将有助于提供紧急人道主义援助，包括紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、卫生用品和医疗服务。 进入一些受影响的社区仍然很困难，道路受损和持续的天气状况阻碍了援助有需要的人的努力。 我们鼓励澳大利亚人通过 EAA 网站或致电 1300 939 000 进行捐款。 参与呼吁的慈善机构包括澳大利亚救助儿童会、澳大利亚国际计划、澳大利亚乐施会、澳大利亚难民署、澳大利亚行动援助组织、澳大利亚援外社、澳大利亚明爱、ADRA、和平行动、圣公会海外援助、澳大利亚路德会世界服务社、澳大利亚浸信会世界援助组织、澳大利亚 CBM 和澳大利亚泪基金。 EAA 执行董事 Kerren Morris 表示，这一呼吁为澳大利亚人提供了一种值得信赖的方式来支持受灾难影响的人们。 她在一份声明中说：“现在迫切需要紧急住所、食物、安全饮用水和医疗支持，而长期恢复工作将持续数月。” 参与其中的慈善机构将不同领域的人道主义专业知识融入到应对工作中，组织及其当地合作伙伴致力于为受影响的社区提供即时援助。 救助儿童会的重点是支持受人道主义紧急情况影响的儿童和家庭。 澳大利亚乐施会的人道主义工作包括支持清洁水、卫生设施和紧急援助等基本服务。 联合国难民署澳大利亚办事处是联合国难民署在澳大利亚的国家合作伙伴，并通过难民署网络支持人道主义援助。 相关慈善机构正在继续评估灾难的规模和受影响社区的人道主义需求。 EAA 表示，随着搜救行动的继续，其成员正在努力确定哪里最需要支持。 该呼吁得到了澳大利亚非政府组织最高机构澳大利亚国际发展委员会（ACFID）的认可......

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal have left entire communities in urgent need of basic necessities. This situation calls us to action, reminding us of our responsibility to advocate for the vulnerable and provide tangible support to those facing such immense hardship. Proverbs 31:8-9 urges us to 'Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水使整个社区迫切需要基本生活必需品。这种情况呼唤我们采取行动，提醒我们有责任为弱势群体发声，并为那些面临巨大困难的人提供切实的支持。《箴言》31:8-9 敦促我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦者伸张正义。你们要开口说话，公正地审判，为困苦和贫穷的人伸张正义。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Number of Australians missing in Nepal floods climbs to 35
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水和山体滑坡造成数百人失踪，其中包括澳大利亚人

summary.en: Aid workers have described scenes of complete destruction, with entire settlements "wiped out".
summary.zh: 救援人员描述了彻底毁灭的景象，整个定居点“被夷为平地”。

body.en:
The Nepal Tourism Board says 35 Australians are missing after a massive flood and landslide disaster on the Nepal-Tibet border killed at least 273 people on Wednesday, with hundreds more unaccounted for.

That number had been 34 until the tourism board published an update Thursday afternoon.

Another 823 people, including 644 Nepali and foreign tourists, remained out of contact in Nepal, according to the country's disaster agency.

On Thursday afternoon, China's foreign minister said nearly 100 Chinese nationals were missing, revising down earlier reporting in Chinese state media that 558 people, including 260 foreigners, were missing in Gyirong Port, Tibet.

"At this point, there are 34 Australians who are missing," Albanese told a press conference on Thursday morning. "People would have seen some of the footage, which is a truly horrific event."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Albanese said it was difficult to obtain information from Nepali authorities and appealed to anyone with information to come forward.

"At this point, Nepal is a developing country. It doesn't have the resources that an event like that would have in Australia, so information is difficult.

"Our thoughts are with all those who will be concerned about their loved ones today."

Defence minister Penny Wong echoed the Prime Minister's statements, noting that the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) was working "urgently" to ascertain the welfare and location of the missing Australians.

"We are currently deploying further DFAT personnel, including crisis response experts to the region to ensure that we do provide the support needed to these posts, particularly our post in Nepal," Wong in a press conference on Thursday.

"At this stage, access and information are very limited given the scale of disaster. We will do our best, to ascertain whatever information we can."

A US-based tour company Himalayan Glacier Adventures told ABC News that 15 Australians, part of a group of 47 people, were on a hiking tour in the Lantang Valley at the time of the landslides.

The group of Australians was comprised of nine men and six women. Two of those Australians were reportedly boys aged 11 and 14, and a woman aged 64.

Tilak Pokharel, president of the Australian Nepalese Multicultural Centre, said there were "a lot" of people in Melbourne waiting anxiously to hear from loved ones.

"There are a lot of people affected by the flood. There are many people from that area living in Melbourne," Pokharel said.

"But several of them lost their property. I was just talking to someone who is from that area and they lost their houses, they lost their property and they have nothing left at...
body.zh: 周三，尼泊尔和西藏边境发生大规模洪水和山体滑坡灾害，造成至少 160 人死亡，数百人失踪，其中据报道有 34 名澳大利亚人。 援助人员表示，整个定居点已被“摧毁”。法新社证实的监控录像显示，一股故事高的碎片撞向边境地区的中国一侧，将卡车和公共汽车抛到一边，数十人逃命。 中国官方媒体报道称，西藏边境枢纽发生泥石流，造成“重大人员伤亡”，其中三人死亡，另有 265 人失踪。 尼泊尔警方表示，他们在“毁灭性洪水”后已找到 157 具尸体，官员“正在努力将洪水风险地区的家庭转移到更安全的地方”。 洪水淹没了多层建筑的较低楼层后，救援人员在泥浆中涉水寻找幸存者。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据尼泊尔旅游部称，灾难发生后数小时内，约 403 名游客（其中 341 名外国人）下落不明。 旅游局发言人向美国广播公司新闻提供的一份名单显示，失踪的澳大利亚人人数为 34 人。 外交贸易部 (DFAT) 尚未确认该数字。 外交贸易部发言人告诉 SBS 新闻：“我们知道该地区有许多澳大利亚人，澳大利亚官员正在紧急努力确认他们的福利。” “我们正在与地方当局以及旅行社联络。” 旅游局称，失踪的外国人包括 142 名印度人，以及来自澳大利亚、英国、马来西亚、荷兰、葡萄牙、南非、韩国和美国的其他人。 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会（IFRC）尼泊尔负责人戴维·费舍尔（David Fisher）表示：“整个村庄和市场区域都被夷为平地。” 该公司表示正在发送紧急物资，包括毯子、急救箱、担架和裹尸袋。 他在社交媒体上发表声明说：“你们所遭受的痛苦和损失并不小。” “但我想向你们保证，在这个困难时期，你们并不孤单——国家将竭尽全力与你们同在。” 当地人受到了创伤，而专家警告说，河流的持续堵塞可能会引发额外的洪水。 “今天早上我接到（我姐夫）的电话，他们哭着说他们的整个房子都被冲走了。三名家庭成员获救，但他的兄弟仍然失踪，”当地56岁的拉朱·巴德尔说。 但尼泊尔外交部长希希尔·卡纳尔表示，地震可能引发山体滑坡，从而阻碍了...

reflection.en: The news of hundreds missing and entire settlements "wiped out" by floods and landslides in Nepal brings immense sorrow. In moments of such widespread devastation and loss of life, the brevity of "Jesus wept" reminds us that grief is a natural and holy response. Yahweh, in Christ, shares in our human pain, offering a compassionate presence when words fail.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔洪水和山体滑坡造成数百人失踪、整个定居点“被夷为平地”的消息，带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此大规模的毁灭和生命损失面前，“雅伟哭了”这简短的经文提醒我们，悲伤是一种自然而神圣的回应。雅伟在基督里分担我们人类的痛苦，当言语无法表达时，祂提供了一个充满怜悯的同在。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: 'Unsafe': Barnaby Joyce invokes disaster-hit Nepal to explain One Nation's refugee policy
title.zh: “不安全”：巴纳比·乔伊斯援引受灾的尼泊尔解释“一国党”的难民政策

summary.en: One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce suggested that Australia should not accept refugees from countries deemed unsafe for Australians to visit, citing flood-hit Nepal as an example.
summary.zh: “一国党”议员巴纳比·乔伊斯建议，澳大利亚不应接收来自政府认为对澳大利亚人来说不安全的国家的难民，并以遭受洪灾的尼泊尔为例。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has suggested that Australia should not accept refugees from countries that the government deems unsafe for Australians to visit, invoking flood-hit Nepal as an example.

Appearing on News24 (formerly Sky News) on Sunday morning, Joyce was asked whether Australia's current humanitarian intake should be cut.

Joyce brought up Nepal, which is reeling from catastrophic mudslides and flash flooding that have killed nearly 700 people. More than 3,000 more are missing, including 42 Australians.

"The refugee program has got to work within a policy structure we've got," Joyce said.

"Remember, we've clearly stated that if an area, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFAT) says it's too unsafe to go there, then it's unsafe to bring people from there and away from there, such as places in Nepal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I presume that the Department of Foreign Affairs says it's not unsafe to go to Nepal, but I wouldn't be going there at the moment."

Asked whether One Nation would stop accepting people from Nepal if DFAT were to advise against travel there, Joyce said he wasn't clear on DFAT's current position on the country, but "I know the Nepalese community have a huge say in sections of our country in the workforce, but they do it within the visa category."

"If they do come in, they'll be within the NOM," he added, referring to net overseas migration.

People who arrive on humanitarian visas currently contribute to net overseas migration figures.

While natural disasters can make a country unsafe to visit, people displaced by disasters do not generally qualify as refugees on that basis alone.

DFAT's latest travel advice for Nepal encourages a "high degree of caution due to the risk of natural disasters and road accidents". For certain areas closer to the disaster-hit region, it advises Australians to reconsider their need to travel.

Pressed on whether One Nation was happy with the current annual humanitarian intake level of 20,000, Joyce repeated that "it fits within the NOM".

"That is our policy, and the refugee policy — it's not that it's dispensed — but you can't come from countries which are dangerous. Like if you can't go there, you shouldn't be coming here."

Reporting suggested this week that the government intended to slash Australia's humanitarian intake by a third, however, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Thursday that humanitarian placements would remain at 20,000.

On Sunday, Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said that was a "permanent commitment".

There has been ongoing confusion over the specifics of One Nation's broader immigration policy.

Yahweh's command in Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us to love the foreigner, recalling that we too were once strangers. This principle calls us to extend welcome and care, especially to those...
reflection.zh: 建议不接收来自像遭受洪灾的尼泊尔这样国家的难民，那里已有数百人死亡，数千人失踪，这挑战了我们对怜悯的理解。雅伟在申命记10:19中的命令提醒我们爱寄居的，并回想我们自己也曾是寄居的。这一原则呼吁我们，特别是对那些逃离严峻困境的人，要给予欢迎和关怀，而不是根据他们的出身而关闭大门。

title.en: Australia should look 'very seriously' at UK-style ban on strangulation porn: minister
title.zh: 澳大利亚部长：应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国禁止勒颈色情内容

summary.en: Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography. Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a...
summary.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑进一步改革网络安全，并应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情内容中描绘勒颈的行为定为非法。她的评论是在一名16岁女孩因涉嫌性勒颈行为死亡后发表的。这起死亡事件重新引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。

body.en:
Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography.

Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a suspected sexual strangulation act.

The death has sparked renewed concern over the rising rate of sexual violence among young people.

According to the Breathless campaign, strangulation — often referred to as "choking" — has become a common sexual practice for young Australians.

The campaign found 57 per cent of young Australians reported being strangled by a partner during sex, while 51 per cent said they had strangled a partner during sex. Among women, 61 per cent said they had experienced strangulation during sex.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Last year, the UK government moved to criminalise porn featuring strangulation or suffocating, introducing a bill that would make it illegal to create or share any such content.

It was recommended in a UK government-commissioned review of online pornography, which found that dangerous practices were being normalised, particularly for young people, through porn.

New South Wales Liberal leader Kelly Sloane has written to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to call for a similar ban in Australia.

"When pornography depicts an act capable of causing brain injury, unconsciousness or death, it should not be treated as just another form of adult entertainment," she said in a statement on Sunday.

Speaking on ABC's Insiders, Plibersek said the government should look seriously at such a ban.

"There is something wrong with a situation where 60 per cent of young people say they've experienced strangulation during sexual encounters," the federal minister said.

Plibersek said it would be crucial to educate young people that pornography is not real life.

"We know that children as young as 10 are seeing pornography before they've had their first kiss; they're getting their sex education from pornography," she said.

The government has already introduced age restrictions for social media and pornography in a bid to limit what young people view online, though concerns have been raised about loopholes .

Federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced on Sunday that the federal government would review the existing consent and respectful relationships program in schools to determine whether it needs strengthening.

Last week, three teen students were charged with the sexual assault of a 14-year-old girl in Bondi, and three boys were charged with the sexual assault of a 17-year-old girl in a...
body.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑围绕网络安全进行进一步改革，并应该“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情作品中的勒杀描述定为非法。 在她发表上述言论之前，一名 16 岁女孩最近因涉嫌性勒颈而死亡。 这起死亡事件再次引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。 据“气喘吁吁”运动称，勒颈——通常被称为“窒息”——已成为澳大利亚年轻人的常见性行为。 该活动发现，57% 的澳大利亚年轻人表示在性行为中被伴侣勒死，而 51% 的人表示他们在性行为中勒死过伴侣。在女性中，61% 的人表示她们在性行为中经历过勒颈。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 去年，英国政府将勒死或窒息的色情内容定为犯罪，并提出一项法案，规定创建或分享任何此类内容均为非法。 英国政府委托对网络色情内容进行的一项审查中建议了这一做法，该审查发现，通过色情内容，危险的做法正在正常化，尤其是对年轻人而言。 新南威尔士州自由党领袖凯利·斯隆（Kelly Sloane）已写信给总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese），呼吁在澳大利亚实施类似的禁令。 她在周日的一份声明中表示：“当色情作品描绘一种能够导致脑损伤、失去知觉或死亡的行为时，它不应被视为成人娱乐的另一种形式。” 普利伯塞克在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 的 Insiders 采访时表示，政府应该认真考虑这样的禁令。 这位联邦部长表示：“60% 的年轻人表示，他们在性接触中经历过勒颈，这种情况是有问题的。” 普利伯塞克表示，教育年轻人色情内容不是现实生活至关重要。 “我们知道，年仅 10 岁的孩子在初吻之前就会看到色情内容；他们从色情内容中接受性教育，”她说。 政府已经对社交媒体和色情内容实行了年龄限制，以限制年轻人在网上观看的内容，尽管有人担心存在漏洞。 联邦教育部长贾森·克莱尔周日宣布，联邦政府将审查学校现有的同意和尊重关系计划，以确定是否需要加强。 上周，邦迪三名青少年学生被指控性侵犯一名 14 岁女孩，三名男孩被指控在邦迪性侵犯一名 17 岁女孩。

reflection.en: The tragic death of a 16-year-old girl and the alarming statistic that 57% of young Australians have experienced strangulation by a partner highlight the urgent need to protect the vulnerable. Minister Tanya Plibersek's consideration of a ban on strangulation pornography reflects a societal concern for the well-being of young people. Yahweh's words in...
reflection.zh: 一名16岁女孩的悲剧性死亡以及57%的澳大利亚年轻人曾被伴侣勒颈的惊人统计数据，凸显了保护弱势群体的迫切需要。社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克考虑禁止勒颈色情内容，反映了社会对年轻人福祉的关注。雅伟在马太福音18:6中的话语提醒我们，我们肩负着保护儿童的重大责任，以及那些伤害他们的人将面临的严重后果，敦使我们创造一个他们能够安全成长的环境。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

title.en: 'Massive changes': What you might find missing in Aussie supermarkets
title.zh: 微小的油性鱼是 TikTok 的最新迷恋。有陷阱吗？

summary.en: ‘Sardinemaxxing’ has emptied supermarket shelves — but the real risk might not be the one you think. Walk down the canned fish aisle at your local supermarket right now, and there's a good chance you'll find a gap where the tinned sardines used to be, as a viral TikTok trend sends a wave of new fans in search of the...
summary.zh: “沙丁鱼最大化”已导致超市货架空空如也——但真正的风险可能并非你所想的那样。 现在去你当地超市的罐头鱼过道走一走，很有可能你会发现罐装沙丁鱼曾经摆放的位置空空如也，因为一个病毒式的 TikTok 趋势正吸引着一大批新粉丝寻找这种小型油性鱼。...

body.en:
Walk down the canned fish aisle at your local supermarket right now, and there's a good chance you'll find a gap where the tinned sardines used to be, as a viral TikTok trend sends a wave of new fans in search of the small, oily fish.

The trend, dubbed "sardinemaxxing", has seen influencers push sardines as a beauty and wellness must-have, with some calling them "Botox on a fork" for their purported skin, hair, and anti-ageing benefits.

But experts say the trend raises real questions about where those sardines are coming from — and what happens if the hype spreads to other seafood.

Sardines are just the latest grocery item swept up in a social media-driven buying frenzy.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Cottage cheese and Greek yoghurt both had their moment in the past year, part of a broader "proteinmaxxing" wave prizing high-protein foods.

Lisa Asher, a retail and supermarket expert at the University of Sydney Business School, said the pattern is driven by a mix of influencer culture and wellness trends.

"What bothers me isn't that the kids are eating sardines … it's that they're taking advice now from people who are probably not people you should be listening to," Asher said.

"It's a new form of advertising with a lot of unknowns — we don't really know who's paying who and how much they're making out of it. That is a problem.

"In magazines, we used to look at celebrities, but celebrities have been replaced by influencers."

She said the trends all follow a similar pattern: demand increases, the product goes out of stock, prices sometimes rise, and eventually, when the hype cools down, it comes back in stock.

"But this is a product that is made from fish in the sea," she adds. "We don't want to overfish because suddenly, then we have none."

Adrian Meder, sustainable seafood program manager at the Australian Marine Conservation Society, says history shows a sudden cultural appetite for a particular seafood can do serious damage — pointing to shark fin soup, sea cucumber and some tuna fisheries as species pushed towards collapse by surging demand.

"We've yet to see online popularity as a driver of major declines in our oceans, but a cultural surge in popularity of a seafood has time and time again decimated populations of species from tunas, to sharks, to abalone, to sea cucumbers," Meder told SBS News.

"Online popularity is clearly capable of producing massive changes in consumer demand."

There's also a traceability problem: much of the tinned sardines on Australian shelves is imported, and it can be difficult to know where a can came from or how sustainably it was caught.

Jonathan Smart, an affiliate...
body.zh: 现在走在当地超市的鱼罐头货架上，你很可能会发现沙丁鱼罐头原来的位置已经空了，因为 TikTok 的病毒式传播趋势吸引了一波新粉丝寻找这种小而油腻的鱼。 这种被称为“沙丁鱼最大化”的趋势，影响力人士将沙丁鱼推崇为美容和健康的必备品，一些人称其为“叉子上的肉毒杆菌”，因为它们据称具有皮肤、头发和抗衰老功效。 但专家表示，这一趋势引发了真正的问题：这些沙丁鱼来自哪里，以及如果这种炒作蔓延到其他海鲜，会发生什么。 沙丁鱼只是社交媒体驱动的购买狂潮中最新的杂货商品。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 白软干酪和希腊酸奶在过去的一年里都风靡一时，它们是推崇高蛋白食品的更广泛的“蛋白质最大化”浪潮的一部分。 悉尼大学商学院零售和超市专家丽莎·阿舍 (Lisa Asher) 表示，这种模式是由影响力文化和健康趋势共同推动的。 “令我困扰的不是孩子们在吃沙丁鱼......而是他们现在接受的建议可能不是你应该倾听的人，”阿舍尔说。 “这是一种新的广告形式，有很多未知因素——我们真的不知道谁付钱给谁，以及他们从中赚了多少钱。这是一个问题。 “在杂志上，我们曾经关注名人，但名人已经被有影响力的人所取代。” 她说，所有趋势都遵循类似的模式：需求增加，产品缺货，价格有时会上涨，最终，当炒作降温时，库存又回来了。 “但这是一种由海里的鱼制成的产品，”她补充道。 “我们不想过度捕捞，因为突然间我们就没有了。” 澳大利亚海洋保护协会可持续海鲜项目经理阿德里安·梅德表示，历史表明，对某种特定海鲜的突然文化需求可能会造成严重损害，他指出，鱼翅汤、海参和一些金枪鱼渔业因需求激增而导致物种濒临崩溃。 梅德告诉 SBS 新闻：“我们还没有看到网络流行度成为海洋资源大幅减少的推动因素，但海鲜文化的流行已经一次又一次地导致金枪鱼、鲨鱼、鲍鱼和海参等物种数量大幅减少。” “网络流行显然能够使消费者需求发生巨大变化。” 还有一个可追溯性问题：澳大利亚货架上的大部分罐装沙丁鱼都是进口的，很难知道罐头来自哪里，或者捕捞的可持续性如何。 乔纳森·斯马特（Jonathan Smart），附属公司...

reflection.en: A viral trend on TikTok has created a run on sardines, with influencers promoting them for beauty benefits. This surge in demand, however, raises questions about the sustainability and sourcing of these fish. Proverbs 11:1 warns against dishonest scales, reminding us that true value lies in integrity, not fleeting hype. As we engage with trends, let us...
reflection.zh: TikTok 上一个病毒式传播的趋势引发了对沙丁鱼的抢购潮，网红们宣传其美容功效。然而，这种需求的激增引发了关于这些鱼类可持续性和来源的疑问。《箴言》11:1 警告说，诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶，提醒我们真正的价值在于诚信，而非短暂的炒作。当我们参与到潮流中时，愿我们能考虑其对现实世界的影响，并在肤浅的诱惑之外寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Labor vows to listen to voters after One Nation's historic WA upset
title.zh: 工党誓言在“一国党”历史性地在西澳州爆冷获胜后倾听选民意见

summary.en: In a significant upset, the One Nation party secured a historic victory in the Western Australian state by-election for the previously safe Labor seat of Secret Harbour. This result saw an 18.6 percent swing against Labor, prompting the party to pledge to listen to voters, with Premier Roger Cook acknowledging that...
summary.zh: 在一次重要的意外中，一国党在西澳大利亚州秘密港区这个此前工党稳固的席位上赢得了历史性的补选胜利。这一结果导致工党支持率下降了18.6%，促使该党承诺倾听选民意见，州长罗杰·库克承认许多人正为高昂的生活成本而挣扎。

body.en:
Labor has pledged to listen to the message from voters after One Nation's historic victory in a formerly safe West Australian seat.

Government-backed candidate Georgia Tree conceded on Sunday after her One Nation opponent Luke Herdegen claimed a state by-election victory the night before.

Voters delivered an 18.6 per cent swing against Labor in the outer Perth electorate of Secret Harbour, handing One Nation its first lower-house seat in the state.

WA Premier Roger Cook, whose party still enjoys an overwhelming parliamentary majority, said the result was a reminder that many people were struggling with high living costs.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"My team will continue to get out and talk to our communities, listen to their concerns and do everything within our powers to make their lives better."

People needed to take the electoral threat posted by One Nation seriously given the party now enjoyed support from a large part of the community, the premier added.

One Nation federal MP Barnaby Joyce said the party's success in WA sent another strong message to Canberra.

"What we've seen there is quite a number of people who basically would have been former Labor Party voters ... they find it easy to make the jump to One Nation."

With about three-quarters of ballots counted, Herdegen had secured 39.1 per cent of first preference results, ahead of Tree's 24.4 per cent and Liberal candidate Ryan Robertson's 17.3 per cent share.

WA One Nation leader Rod Caddies noted the historic moment as he declared "the two-party system is dead".

"Labor have owned this part of Perth. But a safe seat does not stay safe if you ignore it long enough."

"If you think 'oh, these people will just vote for me', then that's a sense of arrogance and arrogance will get your political hide delivered to you on a plate," he said.

Opposition home affairs spokesman Jonathon Duniam said the Liberals should not have admitted the by-election would be a challenge for the party before it even took place.

"When we start talking about conceding or coming in second or finding ways to work with other people before we've even run the race, then yeah, people are not going to back us," he said.

One Nation's performance in WA has been closely watched across the nation, particularly in Victoria and NSW, where state elections are due in November and March respectively.

Cost-of-living pressures, housing shortages and a perceived lack of community amenities topped the list of concerns for voters in Secret Harbour.

Local Luke Pors voted for One Nation, believing the minor party would do a better job than either Labor or the Liberals.

title.en: Why this family is leaving Australia to raise their five children in Lebanon
title.zh: 澳洲的安稳生活与战区的冒险回归：为何如此选择？

summary.en: A 42-year-old mother named Khalil has decided to move her five children from their stable, safe life in Australia back to her native Lebanon. Despite the inherent risks of returning to a war zone, she believes that her children cannot truly inherit their culture, roots, and family connection while living abroad. She...
summary.zh: 42岁的母亲哈利勒（Khalil）决定带着五个孩子离开他们在澳大利亚稳定安全的生活，回到她的家乡黎巴嫩。尽管回到战区存在固有风险，但她认为，如果住在国外，她的孩子们就无法真正继承他们的文化、根脉和家族联系。她将孩子们的身份认同和归属感置于澳大利亚生活所提供的身体安全和机遇之上。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

It's where she built her life and raised five children, watching them grow up with the safety, stability and opportunities she had always hoped to offer them.

Now, the 42-year-old has packed that life into boxes and taken her family back to her native Lebanon.

But because she believes there is something her children cannot inherit from Australia: a childhood lived within reach of their family, their culture and their roots.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

With her eldest now 14, Khalil feels the window to give her children that life is closing.

"We need that for our kids. We need them to learn the values. And we think it's either now or never."

Lebanon remains affected by ongoing hostilities , following Israel's ground invasion in the south of the country in March this year. The Australian government continues to advise Australians not to travel to Lebanon, warning the security situation remains unpredictable and there is a risk of further escalation.

She remembers schools calling parents to collect their children, families sheltering from bombs and nights spent by candlelight during other conflicts in the region.

And yet, when she looks at what her five children stand to gain — grandparents around the corner, aunts and cousins at the dinner table, a community that can catch them when they fall — she considers the risk worth taking.

For Khalil, the move is also about what gets passed from one generation to the next. She left Lebanon when she was 18 and spent the next seven years in the United States before meeting her husband and eventually moving to Australia.

Khalil hails from Jal El Dib, a coastal town north of Beirut, while her husband's family is from southern Lebanon. Cultivating connection to their roots has been a bonding experience for the pair and one they want to pass on to their children.

For many in the Lebanese diaspora, it's a connection that endures across generations, says Paul Tabar, an adjunct professor at the Institute for Culture and Society at Western Sydney University and the founding director of the Institute for Migration Studies at the Lebanese American University in Beirut.

"The Lebanese diaspora, whether in Australia or elsewhere, has maintained a strong connection with its homeland, as have many migrant communities of different nationalities," he tells SBS Arabic.

Khalil points to her husband's connection to the country as an example. He was born and raised in Australia, but his parents migrated from Lebanon in the 1970s and raised him with a strong attachment to the place they left behind.

"He...

title.en: What we know as Australia's bird flu outbreak enters a grim new chapter
title.zh: 禽流感如何在澳大利亚哺乳动物中传播，以及这对您的宠物意味着什么

summary.en: After weeks of spreading among birds, H5 bird flu has been confirmed in three Australian mammal species: a red fox, a dolphin, and a fur seal. Health officials are monitoring the situation as the virus crosses species boundaries, a trend already observed on other continents.
summary.zh: 在鸟类中传播数周后，H5禽流感已在澳大利亚的三种哺乳动物中得到证实：一只红狐、一只海豚和一只毛皮海狮。随着病毒跨越物种界限，卫生官员正密切监测局势。

body.en:
Bird flu has begun its spread beyond birds in Australia, with cases confirmed in three different mammal species since last weekend.

On Friday, Australia's chief veterinary officer, Beth Cookson, said H5 bird flu had been confirmed in a red fox found in metropolitan Adelaide, marking the first in a land mammal in Australia.

A dead dolphin found on South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula also tested positive this week, days after a long-nosed fur seal found dead at Beachport became the country's first mainland mammal case.

Bird flu has been detected in many different mammals on other continents, including cats and dogs, farm animals, dolphins, seals, foxes, tigers, leopards and polar bears.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Infected birds spread the virus through droppings, feathers and other bodily fluids. It can also be transmitted via contaminated clothing, footwear, equipment and vehicles.

Under favourable conditions, the virus can survive in the environment for months, Australian government authorities have said.

While the virus primarily spreads from infected birds, there is evidence it can also spread between some mammals, including during outbreaks in seals and dairy cattle overseas.

Among scavengers like foxes and cats, infections have been linked to eating or interacting with bird carcasses.

Cookson said there was no evidence of mammal-to-mammal transmission of the virus in Australia.

"This detection in a fox is a good reminder that people and their pets should avoid sick or dead wildlife," Cookson said on Friday.

"Although this is a concerning development, it is not unexpected given that H5 bird flu has been detected in other wildlife in areas where there are high levels of infection in wild birds."

The government's H5 bird flu risk assessment ranks multiple dolphin, seal and sea lion species among Australia's most vulnerable native mammals, and experts fear the virus could have devastating consequences for endangered species such as the Australian sea lion.

Seal populations around the world have proved particularly vulnerable to bird flu outbreaks.

The virus decimated southern elephant seal populations on Heard Island after reaching the Australian sub-antarctic territory last year, killing an estimated 75 per cent of pups.

Jane Younger, senior lecturer in Southern Ocean vertebrate ecology at the University of Tasmania, said it was "devastating news for wildlife" that bird flu had been detected in a mainland Australian mammal.

"My biggest concern now is the endangered Australian sea lion, which is found nowhere else in the world," she said.

"Infected and dying seabirds have already been found at important sea lion breeding...
body.zh: 禽流感已开始在澳大利亚的鸟类以外传播，自上周末以来，三种不同的哺乳动物中均出现了病例。 周五，澳大利亚首席兽医官贝丝·库克森 (Beth Cookson) 表示，在阿德莱德大都会发现的一只红狐中已证实感染 H5 禽流感，这是澳大利亚首次在陆地哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 本周，在南澳大利亚弗勒里厄半岛发现的一只死去的海豚也呈阳性，几天前，在海滩港发现的一只长鼻海狗死亡，成为该国首例大陆哺乳动物病例。 其他大陆的许多不同哺乳动物中也发现了禽流感，包括猫和狗、农场动物、海豚、海豹、狐狸、老虎、豹子和北极熊。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 受感染的鸟类通过粪便、羽毛和其他体液传播病毒。它还可以通过受污染的衣服、鞋类、设备和车辆传播。 澳大利亚政府当局表示，在有利的条件下，该病毒可以在环境中存活数月。 虽然该病毒主要通过受感染的鸟类传播，但有证据表明它也可以在一些哺乳动物之间传播，包括海外海豹和奶牛的疫情爆发期间。 在狐狸和猫等食腐动物中，感染与食用或接触鸟类尸体有关。 库克森表示，没有证据表明该病毒在澳大利亚存在哺乳动物之间的传播。 库克森周五表示：“在狐狸身上发现的这一发现很好地提醒人们和他们的宠物应该避免接触生病或死亡的野生动物。” “尽管这一事态发展令人担忧，但考虑到在野鸟感染率高的地区的其他野生动物中也发现了 H5 禽流感，这并不令人意外。” 政府的 H5 禽流感风险评估将多种海豚、海豹和海狮列为澳大利亚最脆弱的本土哺乳动物，专家担心这种病毒可能对澳大利亚海狮等濒临灭绝的物种造成毁灭性后果。 事实证明，世界各地的海豹种群特别容易受到禽流感爆发的影响。 去年，该病毒抵达澳大利亚亚南极地区后，导致赫德岛上的南象海豹数量大量减少，估计导致 75% 的幼崽死亡。 塔斯马尼亚大学南大洋脊椎动物生态学高级讲师简·杨格（Jane Younger）表示，在澳大利亚大陆的哺乳动物中发现了禽流感，这对野生动物来说是“毁灭性的消息”。 “我现在最担心的是濒临灭绝的澳大利亚海狮，这种动物在世界其他地方都找不到，”她说。 “在重要的海狮繁殖场所已经发现了受感染和垂死的海鸟......

reflection.en: The discovery of bird flu in a red fox in Adelaide and a dolphin on the Fleurieu Peninsula reminds us that the health of one part of creation is deeply linked to the rest. When one species suffers, the ripple effects eventually reach across the boundaries of land and sea, affecting mammals and potentially our own households. This groaning of the natural...
reflection.zh: 在阿德莱德的红狐和菲尔里厄半岛的海豚身上发现禽流感，提醒我们受造界某一部分的健康与其余部分紧密相连。当一个物种遭受苦难时，其连锁反应最终会跨越陆地和海洋的界限，影响到哺乳动物，甚至可能波及我们的家庭。这种自然界的叹息呼唤我们建立更深层的管家意识，并以祷告的心去关注雅伟委托我们照管的生命的脆弱性。

title.en: What weather can we expect across Australia this spring?
title.zh: 澳大利亚今年春天天气如何？

summary.en: After a warm winter, Australians are entering spring under the influence of an El Niño that is expected to intensify further.
summary.zh: 在经历了一个温暖的冬季之后，澳大利亚人即将进入春天，而厄尔尼诺现象预计将进一步加剧。

body.en:
Warmer-than-usual weather is expected to continue across much of Australia from winter into spring.

The Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has released its long-range forecast for September to November, predicting that both daytime and overnight temperatures are likely to be above average in most of the country.

Rainfall is expected to be below average across parts of Australia's south and east, and above average across much of the western half of the country.

The bureau notes that spring is also a peak time of year for severe thunderstorms, especially along the east coast.

"The warmer forecast increases the risk of early-season heat, particularly across southern Australia," said David Crock, senior BoM meteorologist.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"While rainfall is expected to be below average in some areas, this does not mean it will be dry all the time. It means there is likely to be less rainfall than usual."

Spring rainfall is likely to be below average in much of Victoria, southern NSW and the ACT, north and east Tasmania, parts of eastern Queensland, southern South Australia and pockets of the far north Northern Territory.

Above average rainfall is expected across parts of north-west South Australia and across most of Western Australia, with the exception of the south-western corner.

The forecast coincides with a strengthening El Niño, expected to be one of the strongest on record, increasing the chances of hot, dry weather and raising concerns for farmers and bushfire agencies .

The spring bushfire outlook is varied across the country, with increased fire risks expected in some regions, including parts of Victoria, NSW and WA.

The BoM expects El Niño to strengthen and persist through spring and summer.

But while the climate driver is associated with drier conditions across parts of Australia, the agency said the strength of an El Niño doesn't always match its impacts on Australian rainfall.

"Oceans around Australia and globally are also much warmer than usual, adding moisture and energy that can fuel rain systems," Crock said.

A study published last week found the Pacific climate pattern that drives El Niño and La Niña is showing larger swings, with more frequent and intense El Niño events than at any time in the past millennium, adding to evidence that climate change is amplifying one of the world's most influential climate systems.

Australia's snow season, which runs from June to October, is set to be one of the worst on record, despite plenty of moisture passing over the Australian Alps.

body.zh: 从冬季到春季，澳大利亚大部分地区的天气预计将持续温暖。 气象局 (BoM) 发布了 9 月至 11 月的长期预报，预测该国大部分地区的白天和夜间气温可能高于平均水平。 预计澳大利亚南部和东部部分地区的降雨量将低于平均水平，而该国西半部大部分地区的降雨量将高于平均水平。 该局指出，春季也是一年中严重雷暴的高峰期，尤其是在东海岸。 BoM 高级气象学家 David Crock 表示：“温暖的预测增加了早季高温的风险，特别是在澳大利亚南部。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “虽然一些地区的降雨量预计将低于平均水平，但这并不意味着天气会一直干燥。这意味着降雨量可能会比平常少。” 维多利亚州大部分地区、新南威尔士州南部和首都领地、塔斯马尼亚州北部和东部、昆士兰州东部部分地区、南澳大利亚州南部以及北领地北部部分地区的春季降雨量可能低于平均水平。 南澳大利亚州西北部部分地区和西澳大利亚州大部分地区（西南角除外）预计降雨量将高于平均水平。 这一预测恰逢厄尔尼诺现象加强，预计将是有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象之一，增加出现炎热、干燥天气的可能性，并引发农民和丛林火灾机构的担忧。 全国各地的春季森林火灾前景各不相同，预计某些地区的火灾风险将会增加，包括维多利亚州、新南威尔士州和西澳州的部分地区。 央行预计厄尔尼诺现象将加强并持续整个春季和夏季。 不过，尽管气候驱动因素与澳大利亚部分地区的干旱状况有关，但该机构表示，厄尔尼诺现象的强度并不总是与其对澳大利亚降雨量的影响相匹配。 克罗克说：“澳大利亚和全球各地的海洋也比平时温暖得多，增加了水分和能量，为降雨系统提供燃料。” 上周发表的一项研究发现，导致厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜现象的太平洋气候模式正呈现出更大的波动，厄尔尼诺事件比过去千年中的任何时候都更加频繁和强烈，这进一步证明气候变化正在加剧世界上最具影响力的气候系统之一。 澳大利亚的雪季从六月到十月，尽管澳大利亚阿尔卑斯山上空有大量湿气，但预计将是有记录以来最糟糕的雪季之一。 “如果空气足够冷，使降水以雪的形式落下，这将是最好的雪之一......

body.en: A 102-year-old woman, who is understood to be the mother of late singer Anita Mui, died on Sunday after she collapsed while eating. Police were alerted at about 10am by a domestic helper who said the woman had collapsed in a flat on Leighton Road in Causeway Bay. She was rushed to Ruttonjee Hospital in an unconscious state and later pronounced dead. It is understood that the woman had a history of heart disease and hypertension, and required a liquid diet and regular medication. Sources said police officers found no suspicious injuries on the woman's body, and no suspicious objects in her residence. Edited by Aaron Tam

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. Latest figures from both...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. A team of Nepal police and National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) retrieves money and documents from a bank covered in sludge in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 30, 2026. Photo: Arun Sankar/AFP. Latest figures from both countries put the number of missing at 3,044 , with a further 750 confirmed deaths — and reports of some bodies possibly swept downstream as far away as India. The disaster, which struck the China-Nepal border Wednesday morning, was caused by a glacial collapse, sending a wall of water and debris downstream, the US Geological Survey said. Chinese rescuers near the Tibet border port that was hit by a deadly mudslide were “moved to a safe location” Sunday, after a new lake was formed by a landslide, state media reported. Nepali army troops and engineers were working on Sunday to rescue workers believed trapped in a tunnel at the Trishuli 3A hydroelectric site after they successfully inserted a pipe into the passage. They have “started sending air through the small opening”, Nepali Home Minister Sudan Gurung said in a statement. Embed from Getty Images Overnight rain and rising river waters hampered efforts early Sunday, filling the excavation area with water before conditions eased and teams resumed efforts, the Nepal army said. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority listed 933 hydropower workers among the missing. China’s state news agency Xinhua reported on Sunday that experts had said “a glacier on the southern slope of Lirung Peak in Nepal” fractured, triggering an ice-rock avalanche. It said the torrent plummeted rapidly, forming a massive debris flow that travelled more than 20 kilometres before crashing into Gyirong Port. “The sudden glacial collapse and flash flood is a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be,” UN climate chief Simon Steill said in a statement. ‘Nothing left’ Survivors face an agonising wait to learn the fate of missing relatives and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away,” Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP in Nepal’s Nuwakot district. “There is nothing left.” At an army base serving as a rescue hub in Bidur, relatives crowded around lists of rescued people pasted on a wall. “I have come here looking for my son,” said Kalka Sharda,...
body.zh: 周日，一道致命的水墙和碎片席卷喜马拉雅山，吞没了整个村庄，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员在泥泞、河流上涨和新形成的湖泊的威胁下奋力搜寻数千名失踪人员。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区 Trishuli 发生山洪，尼泊尔警察和国家减少灾害风险管理局 (NDRRMA) 组成的团队从一家被污泥覆盖的银行取回资金和文件。照片：Arun Sankar/法新社。两国的最新数据显示，失踪人数为 3,044 人，另有 750 人确诊死亡，据报道，一些尸体可能被冲到下游，远至印度。美国地质调查局称，周三上午发生在中国和尼泊尔边境的这场灾难是由冰川崩塌造成的，导致水墙和碎片向下游流动。据官方媒体报道，西藏边境口岸附近遭受致命泥石流袭击的中国救援人员周日“被转移到安全地点”，山体滑坡形成了一个新的湖泊。周日，尼泊尔军队和工程师正在努力营救据信被困在 Trishuli 3A 水电站隧道中的工人，他们成功地将一根管道插入通道。尼泊尔内政部长苏丹古隆在一份声明中表示，他们已经“开始通过小开口输送空气”。尼泊尔军方表示，夜间降雨和不断上涨的河水阻碍了周日早些时候的工作，在情况缓解且工作人员恢复工作之前，挖掘区域已被水淹没。在一个拥有大型能源基础设施项目的地区，尼泊尔救灾当局将 933 名水电工人列为失踪人员。中国官方通讯社新华社周日报道称，专家表示，“尼泊尔利隆峰南坡的一座冰川”破裂，引发了冰岩雪崩。据称，洪流急速下降，形成巨大泥石流，行程20多公里，冲入吉隆口岸。联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯泰尔在一份声明中表示：“突然的冰川崩塌和山洪爆发毁灭性地提醒人们，这些山区环境是多么脆弱。” “一无所有”幸存者面临着痛苦的等待，他们想了解失踪亲人的命运，以及从一无所有中重建生活的前景。尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的布迪·拉姆·丹戈尔（Buddhi Ram Dangol）告诉法新社：“河流附近的所有定居点都被冲走了。” “什么都没有剩下了。”在比杜尔的一个作为救援中心的军事基地，亲属们围在墙上贴着的获救人员名单周围。 “我来这里是为了寻找我的儿子，”卡尔卡·沙达说……

title.en: Schools can scale up by merging: education chief
title.zh: 教育局长：学校可以通过合并扩大规模

summary.en: Secretary for Education Christine Choi on Sunday said authorities would notify in advance schools that may not have enough students to form a primary one class. Authorities would also offer assistance to schools that need to merge amid a decline in the number of school-age...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Secretary for Education Christine Choi on Sunday said authorities would notify in advance schools that may not have enough students to form a primary one class. Authorities would also offer assistance to schools that need to merge amid a decline in the number of school-age children, she said. Her remarks came as it was revealed that 15 schools were unable to operate a primary one class in the coming 2026-27 academic year, after failing to get the minimum of 16 pupils. Speaking on a TVB programme, Choi said authorities are observing the trend of students in the coming five to 10 years. Schools that may not have enough students would receive an early notification to take action, she said. “We encourage schools to enhance quality through merging. Instead of waiting till they fail to form a primary one class, we expect schools to join forces and expand their scale with more resources,” she said. “Therefore, except for the existing options, we hope school sponsoring bodies can take the initiative to see if there are schools with similar focuses, so that they can pool resources and achieve a greater scale.” Meanwhile, Choi also said a three-tier mechanism to support students with mental health risks has proven to be helpful. She said authorities would explore how to make the best use of the mechanism and further enhance coordination between schools and off-campus support. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 教育局局长蔡恭蕙周日表示，当局将提前通知可能没有足够学生组成小学一年级的学校。她说，当局还将向因学龄儿童人数下降而需要合并的学校提供​​援助。她发表上述言论之际，有消息称，有 15 所学校因未达到 16 名学生的最低人数要求，无法在即将到来的 2026-27 学年开设小学一年级。崔在TVB节目中表示，当局正在观察未来五到十年的学生趋势。她说，可能没有足够学生的学校将提前收到采取行动的通知。 “我们鼓励学校通过合并来提高质量。我们希望学校不要等到无法组建小一班，而是联合起来，利用更多资源扩大规模。”她说。 “因此，除了现有的选择外，我们希望办学机构能够主动看看是否有类似侧重点的学校，以便集中资源，实现更大的规模。”与此同时，崔还表示，为有心理健康风险的学生提供支持的三层机制已被证明是有帮助的。她表示，当局将探讨如何充分利用该机制，进一步加强校内和校外支持之间的协调。谭咏麟编辑

title.en: Northern Metropolis tender marks milestone: FS
title.zh: 北方都市招标标志着里程碑：FS

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan on Sunday said the large-scale land disposal approach in Northern Metropolis development could leverage resources in the private market and achieve a win-win result. His remarks came after the government awarded the first tender for a major land...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan on Sunday said the large-scale land disposal approach in Northern Metropolis development could leverage resources in the private market and achieve a win-win result. His remarks came after the government awarded the first tender for a major land parcel to HSK New Development that comprises six shareholders: China Overseas Land and Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land, China Travel Service, JD.com and a subsidiary of Sino Land. Writing in his weekly blog, the finance chief noted the consortium consists of firms with capabilities in infrastructure development, technological innovation, facility operations, supply chain management and ecosystem building. Chan said the bid price was not the government’s sole consideration. Instead, the authorities placed greater emphasis on whether the bidder could introduce strategic industries, create jobs and drive the development of industry chains. The minister said the large-scale land disposal approach could effectively mobilise resources in the private market and make good use of the market’s flexibility, sensitivity and expertise to speed up development progress. The approach would also ensure that projects – from design and construction to future operations – better meet users’ needs, while reducing the government’s financial input, he added. Chan said the tender marked a milestone for the development of the Northern Metropolis, and the government would maintain communication with the market. He added that a financial advisory taskforce would tailor-make financing arrangements for the Northern Metropolis development. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波周日表示，北都开发的大规模土地处置方式可以利用私人市场的资源，实现双赢。在他发表上述言论之前，政府向HSK新发展公司授予了第一块主要地块的招标权，该公司由六家股东组成：中国海外发展、招商局置地、华润置地、中国旅行社、京东和信和置业的子公司。这位财务主管在每周博客中写道，该财团由具有基础设施开发、技术创新、设施运营、供应链管理和生态系统建设能力的公司组成。陈表示，投标价格并不是政府的唯一考虑因素。相反，当局更加看重竞标者能否引进战略产业、创造就业机会、带动产业链发展。部长表示，大规模土地处置方式可以有效调动私人市场资源，充分利用市场的灵活性、敏感性和专业性，加快开发进度。他补充说，这种方法还将确保项目从设计、施工到未来运营更好地满足用户的需求，同时减少政府的财政投入。陈茂波表示，此次招标是北都发展的里程碑，政府会与市场保持沟通。他补充说，财务咨询工作组将为北方都市开发量身定制融资安排。谭咏麟编辑

title.en: SAR lawyers' role elevated by law revision: Starry Lee
title.zh: 李慧琼：修法提升特区律师的作用

summary.en: Hong Kong's top representative to the National People's Congress welcomed recent amendments to the national Lawyers Law, saying legal professionals from the two SARs can take on a more prominent role in legal and arbitration services in the Greater Bay Area (GBA). Under new...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Hong Kong's top representative to the National People's Congress welcomed recent amendments to the national Lawyers Law, saying legal professionals from the two SARs can take on a more prominent role in legal and arbitration services in the Greater Bay Area (GBA). Under new provisions passed on Friday by the National People's Congress Standing Committee (NPCSC), lawyers from Hong Kong and Macao who pass an examination can provide services on specified matters in nine Guangdong cities. The permanent regulations, which take effect next month, are a continuation of a pilot scheme which began in 2020, and extended in 2023. As of June, over 650 lawyers have passed the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Legal Professional Examination and obtained a GBA Lawyer's Licence. The test is administered by the State Council's judicial administration department, which also decides on the scope of practice for the applicants. Speaking to reporters on Sunday, NPCSC delegate Starry Lee expressed optimism about the impact of the amendments. "I expect that more Hong Kong lawyers will be willing, or will continue, to obtain the Greater Bay Area lawyer qualification, and thereby participate in mainland legal work, especially in foreign-related law," she said. The Legislative Council president added that as the country pursues a high-level opening-up policy, there has been a consistent emphasis on strengthening the training of legal professionals with expertise in international law. Lee also highlighted Hong Kong's unique advantages under its common law system, describing the city as one of the nation's most open and internationalised jurisdictions. By practising in the GBA or engaging in cross-border arbitration, she said, Hong Kong lawyers can play a vital role in advancing the mainland's legal capabilities in foreign-related matters. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 香港全国人大代表对国家律师法最近的修订表示欢迎，并表示两个特别行政区的法律专业人士可以在大湾区的法律和仲裁服务中发挥更重要的作用。根据全国人大常委会周五通过的新规定，通过考试的香港和澳门律师可以在广东九市提供特定事项的服务。将于下个月生效的永久规定是自2020年开始并于2023年延续的试点计划的延续。截至6月，已有超过650名律师通过粤港澳大湾区法律职业考试并取得大湾区律师执照。考试由国务院司法行政部门组织实施，并决定报考人员的执业范围。全国人大常委会代表李慧琼周日在接受记者采访时对修正案的影响表示乐观。她说：“我预计会有更多的香港律师愿意或者会继续取得大湾区律师资格，从而参与内地法律工作，特别是涉外法律工作。”立法会主席补充说，国家奉行高水平对外开放政策，一贯重视加强国际法法律人才培养。李还强调了香港在普通法体系下的独特优势，称香港是全国最开放和国际化的司法管辖区之一。她表示，通过在大湾区执业或参与跨境仲裁，香港律师可以在提升内地涉外法律能力方面发挥重要作用。杨雷蒙编辑

In times of economic uncertainty, the weight of debt can feel overwhelming, impacting individuals and businesses alike. This situation...
reflection.zh: 香港商业地产市场的新闻显示，由于利率飙升，高杠杆业主面临再融资挑战，这提醒我们古老的智慧：“欠债的是债主的奴仆。”在经济不确定时期，债务的重担可能令人不堪重负，影响着个人和企业。这种情况呼唤着审慎，并信靠雅伟的供应，认识到真正的自由往往超越财务纠葛。

title.en: China tightens rules on selling unfinished homes to lift sector
title.zh: 中国收紧销售未完工房屋的规定以提振行业

summary.en: Chinese officials tightened the rules for selling unfinished homes on Friday as they try to lift the country’s property market out of a years-long slump that has weighed on consumption. Half-built apartment buildings dot cities across China, relics of a property boom that came...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chinese officials tightened the rules for selling unfinished homes on Friday as they try to lift the country’s property market out of a years-long slump that has weighed on consumption. File photo: Shuxuan Cao, via Pexels. Half-built apartment buildings dot cities across China, relics of a property boom that came to a halt when the government clamped down on excessive borrowing and rampant speculation in 2020. That left several developers grappling with massive debt — wreaking havoc on buyers who poured their savings into new homes that were never finished. Chinese officials instructed local authorities on Friday to “vigorously and orderly promote the sale of ready-to-move-in commercial housing”, while they also urged more protections for buyers who purchase homes before construction is complete. The instructions came in a joint statement from China’s National Financial Regulatory Administration, as well as Beijing’s housing and natural resource ministries. The financial regulator and China’s central bank also announced on Friday new lending guidelines that raise the maximum length for personal housing loans to 40 years, from the existing 30-year mortgage limit. “These policies are a meaningful step in the right direction,” wrote Zhiwei Zhang, President and Chief Economist at Pinpoint Asset Management. The Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. “The decision to allow mortgage loans up to 40 years helps to mitigate the home buyers’ debt burden,” he said. China’s leaders have battled sluggish domestic spending since the end of the Covid-19 pandemic, which has threatened growth even as exports and certain high-tech sectors boom. “The weak domestic demand is to a large extent due to the troubled property sector,” Zhang said, adding that the new housing policies showed officials “understand the urgency” to stabilise the market.
body.zh: 中国官员周五收紧了销售未完工房屋的规定，试图使中国房地产市场摆脱多年来拖累消费的低迷状态。资料照片：曹树轩，来自 Pexels。半建的公寓楼遍布中国各地的城市，这是房地产热潮的遗迹，随着政府在 2020 年打击过度借贷和猖獗的投机活动，房地产热潮陷入停滞。这让一些开发商陷入巨额债务的困境，这对那些将积蓄投入到从未完工的新房的买家造成了严重破坏。中国官员周五指示地方当局“大力有序促进商品房预售”，同时他们还敦促为在工程竣工前购房的购房者提供更多保护。这些指示是在中国国家金融监督管理局以及北京住建部和自然资源部的联合声明中发布的。金融监管机构和中国央行周五还宣布了新的贷款指导方针，将个人住房贷款的最长期限从现有的 30 年抵押贷款期限提高到 40 年。 “这些政策是朝着正确方向迈出的有意义的一步，”品点资产管理公司总裁兼首席经济学家张志伟写道。北京人民大会堂。照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。 “允许抵押贷款期限长达 40 年的决定有助于减轻购房者的债务负担，”他说。自Covid-19大流行结束以来，中国领导人一直在与国内支出低迷作斗争，尽管出口和某些高科技行业蓬勃发展，但国内支出仍威胁着经济增长。张说：“内需疲软在很大程度上是由于房地产行业陷入困境。”他补充说，新的住房政策表明官员“理解”稳定市场的紧迫性。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Number of missing in Nepal, China floods soars to nearly 3,000
title.zh: 尼泊尔和中国洪灾失踪人数飙升至近3000人

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China are continuing efforts to locate nearly 3,000 people missing after deadly floods swept through the Himalayan region. The disaster has resulted in 633 recovered bodies, with some potentially carried downstream into India, and has also affected 933 hydropower workers.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和中国的救援人员仍在努力寻找在喜马拉雅地区致命洪水中失踪的近3000人。这场灾难已导致633具遗体被发现，其中一些可能被冲到印度下游，另有933名水电工人也受到影响。

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages. A woman looks at photographs of the missing and dead following flash floods in Nepal, outside a hospital in Kathmandu on August 29, 2026. Photo: Prakash Mathema/AFP. The number of missing soared close to 3,000 Saturday, latest figures from both countries showed, with 633 bodies recovered — and reports of some dead possibly swept downstream as far away as India. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority added 933 hydropower workers to a missing persons list already including trekkers and pilgrims to Tibet’s sacred Mount Kailash. Those that made it out say they have lost everything and now face an agonising wait to discover the fate of missing loved ones, and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away. There is nothing left,” survivor Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP. Samjhana Thing said she had been waiting three days for news of her missing brother.
